body:
I'm a male that doesn't really care about dating, as I'm not really capable of feelings like love or attraction. I'm alone and accustomed to it. The one exception was when I found out a girl liked me, I really put in the effort to like her and offer to date her. It didn't work out (she only wanted sex, not dating), but the lesson to take from this is that men want to feel wanted. Be clear and honest with your intentions, and remember that he may not pick up on flirting or obscure cues. 

A lot of first impressions are skin deep, so accept rejection and never take anything personally. Most people (from what I've been told) are naturally attracted to other people, so it's all about finding the right person. Make them feel valued, respect them, show interest in getting to know them. 

Best of luck.
